# Memolite — Good First Spots

*Generated by the **repo-tour** skill. Each symbol below is a callable leaf in
the Graphify knowledge graph with degree 1 — i.e. the graph shows at most one

`pytest` before and after.*

## MCP server tools — add features users will see
The MCP tools are thin degree-1 wrappers; extending one (or adding a sibling
tool) touches almost nothing else.

| Symbol | Where | Degree |
|---|---|---:|
| `remember()` | `src/memolite/mcp_server.py:L26` | 1 |
| `recall()` | `src/memolite/mcp_server.py:L32` | 1 |
| `health()` | `src/memolite/mcp_server.py:L40` | 1 |

**Starter task:** add a `forget` or `stats` MCP tool next to these, mirroring
their shape, plus a test like `tests/test_adapters.py:L56` (`test_mcp_import()`).

## Test helpers (if your first PR is a test improvement)
Degree-1 helpers/fakes you can extend without touching production code:
`create()` (`tests/test_autoload.py:L13`), `__init__()`
(`tests/test_autoload.py:L70`), `evil()` (`tests/test_killer.py:L79`),
`__enter__()`/`__exit__()` (`tests/test_p4.py:L178`/`L181`),
`create()` (`tests/test_p4.py:L155`), and the CLI tests in
`tests/test_cli.py` (`L8`, `L42`, `L54`, `L75`).

---
*Why trust this list? Degree comes from the knowledge graph: a leaf node with
degree ≤ 2 provably has almost no dependents in the extracted structure. What
the graph can't see (runtime reflection, external callers) is why you still
run the test suite.*
